# 📋 Instruções para Atualizar Descrições das Milestones

Este arquivo contém as descrições recomendadas para cada milestone no GitHub. Copie e cole estas descrições no campo "Description" de cada milestone.

## 🔧 Como Atualizar

1. Acesse: https://github.com/usesnipet/snipet/milestones
2. Clique em cada milestone para editar
3. Copie a descrição correspondente abaixo para o campo de descrição
4. Clique em "Save"

---

## 📦 Milestone 0.1.0 (CLOSED)

**Título:** Core Plugin System & LLM Providers Foundation

**Descrição:**
```
Foundation of the plugin system and LLM provider infrastructure.

Established the base structure for extensibility including:
- JSON-based plugin templates for easy plugin creation
- Multiple LLM provider integrations (OpenAI, Claude, etc.)
- Unified plugin-like structure for LLM providers

Status: ✅ Completed on October 15, 2026
Issues: #6, #11, #12
```

---

## 📦 Milestone 0.2.0 (CLOSED)

**Título:** Debug & Observability System + Widget

**Descrição:**
```
Introduction of comprehensive debugging capabilities and agent monitoring infrastructure.

Key features implemented:
- Complete debug system for agent execution with real-time monitoring
- Persistent settings module for key-value configurations
- Debug mode reporting at session initialization
- Debugger for agent runs with data storage for analysis
- Anonymous login support for embedded widget
- Web framework integration library for widget deployment

Status: ✅ Completed on October 16, 2026
Issues: #14, #16, #18, #19, #20, #21, #24 (7 issues)
```

---

## 📦 Milestone 0.2.1 (CLOSED)

**Título:** Release Pipeline Optimization

**Descrição:**
```
Patch release focused on improving the release automation process.

Improvements:
- Skip already published npm packages to prevent re-publishing
- Faster and more reliable release pipeline

Status: ✅ Completed on October 19, 2026
Issues: #27
```

## 📦 Milestone 0.2.2 (CLOSED)

**Título:** Documentation & Architecture Refactoring

**Descrição:**
```
Focus on documentation completeness and simplifying project architecture.

Deliverables:
- Comprehensive README files for all apps and packages
- Removal of knowledge module to simplify architecture
- Clear separation of concerns and responsibilities

Status: ✅ Completed on October 19, 2026
Issues: #28, #29
```

## 📦 Milestone 0.3.0 (OPEN)

**Título:** MCP Integration & Cost Monitoring

**Descrição:**
```
Expand agent capabilities with MCP support, cost monitoring, and advanced command system.

In Progress:
- Cost monitoring system for LLM API usage tracking
- MCP (Model Context Protocol) instruction integration in agent context
- Security improvements (CORS origin validation)
- Comprehensive project documentation and landing page

Sub-features in development (#34 - Add commands to agent):
- Support for Claude Skills and AI agent integration
- MCP server prompts support
- Internal builtin commands
- Snipet owner command pattern

Status: 🚀 In Development (est. completion date pending)
Issues: #22, #30, #33, #39 (+ #34, #35, #36, #37, #38)
Progress: ~50% (4 main issues + 4 sub-tasks)
```
